notes:
Two fixes for paired tablets.

**The second tablet no longer comes up blank when you pair.** Connecting two tablets while the first was on the Library screen could leave the second showing a plain white screen instead of the Obbligato logo, and it stayed that way until the app was closed and reopened. It now shows the logo straight away.

**Handwriting no longer vanishes when you leave edit mode from the second tablet.** Leaving edit mode from the second tablet could leave your annotations invisible until you turned a page or toggled edit mode again. Doing it from the main tablet was already fine; now both are.

Nothing was ever lost in either case — the handwriting was always saved, it just wasn't being redrawn. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
